fields.PRODUCT NAME: Rajasthani Marble Decorative Plate with Royal Elephant Painting
fields.DESCRIPTION: This exquisite hand-painted marble decorative plate showcases the timeless beauty of Rajasthani artistry. Featuring a vibrant peacock motif, the national bird of India and a symbol of grace and prosperity, it is surrounded by intricate floral designs in traditional meenakari-style patterns. Handcrafted by skilled artisans, this plate is made from premium quality marble and adorned with fine detailing in rich colors and golden highlights. It comes with a wooden stand, making it a perfect showpiece for living rooms, offices, or gifting on special occasions.
